executive_summary: Strategic product charter for LE LEVAIN, an artisanal Portland sourdough bakery establishing a premier digital flagship. The product strategy anchors on hyper-transparent daily baking schedule tracking and a recurring sourdough loaf subscription engine, driving local pickup density and repeat community retention.

value_pillars.strategic_rationale: Demystify heritage grain sourcing, 36-hour slow fermentation, and exact oven pull schedules to validate premium price point and elevate artisanal authority over commodity bakeries.
Convert sporadic walk-in customers into high-LTV weekly subscribers with flexible cadence choices (weekly/bi-weekly), automated batch reservation, and zero-churn pause/skip mechanics.
Create authentic daily visit rituals via dynamic bake schedules (morning, mid-day baguettes, evening focaccia), driving pre-orders before loaves sell out.
Position the bakery as a central community hub through localized pickup logistics, seasonal Pacific Northwest flour collaborations, and community events.

target_personas.title: The Discerning Culinary Enthusiast (Local Foodie)
pain_points: Frustrated by arriving at popular bakeries only to find signature sourdough sold out
Distrustful of industrial additive-laden sourdough sold in supermarket chains
Lacks time to bake slow-ferment sourdough at home on weekdays
jobs_to_be_done: Check daily baking schedule to time afternoon pickups perfectly
Set up automated weekly bread box deliveries/pickups for staple sourdough and seasonal specialty loaves

target_personas.title: The Neighborhood Daily Regular (Work-from-Home Neighbor)
pain_points: Requires quick morning espresso and warm pastry before starting remote meetings
Dislikes cumbersome ordering apps with long checkout steps for small daily orders
jobs_to_be_done: Quickly view morning pastry drop times and today's bread schedule at a glance
Reserve daily baguette and loaf for evening dinner table without friction

target_personas.title: The Sustainable Household Caretaker
pain_points: Wants clean-ingredient, gut-friendly fermented breads for family meals
Needs predictable weekly budgeting and effortless subscription modification for travel/vacations
jobs_to_be_done: Subscribe to a multi-loaf family subscription with granular pause, skip, and flavor-swap controls
Access transparent allergen and heritage grain provenance information

in_scope_features: Interactive Daily Baking Schedule board displaying batch drop times, batch status (Fermenting, In Oven, Freshly Pulled, Sold Out), and flour composition
Sourdough Loaf Recurring Subscription Builder (selection of loaf style, delivery/pickup cadence, add-on spreads/pastries, and checkout flow)
Hearth Availability & Pre-order reservation system for same-day scheduled store pickup
Artisanal Provenance & Heritage Grain Transparency Showcase detailing regional Pacific Northwest mill partnerships and fermentation methodology
Customer Account Hub for subscription frequency toggling, skip-week management, and pickup slot selection
Bakery Location, Neighborhood Pickup Logistics, and Operating Hours information module
out_of_scope_features: Nationwide or cross-state cold-chain shipping logistics (restricted exclusively to Portland metro area pickup and local delivery)
Real-time courier GPS route tracking or custom driver dispatch infrastructure
Complex multi-vendor marketplace or external culinary reseller portal
Catering quote builder and enterprise commercial B2B wholesale invoicing
success_metrics: Achieve >= 18% conversion rate from schedule viewers to pre-order or subscription actions
Maintain >= 65% active subscriber retention rate at 90 days post-onboarding
Reduce daily walk-in sell-out dissatisfaction by shifting >= 40% of morning sourdough allocations to digital reservations
Achieve < 45 seconds median user journey time from landing page visit to completed subscription checkout
strategic_assumptions: Target audience is centered within Portland metropolitan area with high demand for organic, naturally leavened artisan goods
The bakery operates a predictable daily bake cycle with 2-3 distinct oven pulls per day
Fulfillment model supports both scheduled store counter pickup and localized third-party bicycle/eco-courier delivery radius
Downstream design and engineering teams will operate in detached decoupled modes respecting strict tier contracts
